author: SHADOW
name: Battleship
short: Channel battleship vs a member or Cog-800.
description: Play battleship in a channel against another member or Cog-800. One game per channel, one edited image. The public chart shows hits and misses only. Hulls stay hidden until that ship is sunk. Setup and My fleet are private.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Battleship by SHADOW. Start with [p]battleship bot. Charts are images, so the bot needs Attach Files. Pillow is installed with this cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores one guild setting in Red Config: whether to ping the player on their shot. Live games stay in memory and are deleted when the game ends, is surrendered, or expires. No match history is written to disk.
